questions.q: What did Hsieh learn from hiring too many people too quickly?
a: Company culture is the strongest predictor of success
Fast hiring is the only way to keep up with growth
Skills matter far more than personality fit
New employees should be left to define their own roles
questions.why: Lesson 1 says the experience taught him to hire slowly and protect the culture.

questions.q: Why does the summary rank company culture above customer service?
a: People who dislike their workplace cannot serve customers well
Customer service can always be handled by outside firms
Culture directly lowers the cost of shipping shoes
Customers never notice how employees are treated
questions.why: Lesson 1 argues that great service naturally follows from a healthy work environment.

questions.q: What one thing did Zappos decide to be the best in the world at?
a: Customer service
Low prices
Widest selection
Fastest website
questions.why: Lesson 2 says Zappos chose customer service rather than price, selection or rarity.

questions.q: What does "never outsource the one thing you are great at" mean in practice?
a: You can hand off supporting tasks but not your signature strength
You should perform every task in the company yourself
You should outsource whatever takes the most time
You should copy whatever your competitor outsources
questions.why: Lesson 2's pizza example says you may let others make it, but you deliver it.

questions.q: How did Zappos attract attention without a marketing budget?
a: It poured profits into service until customers and the press spread the word
It paid journalists to write about its unusual office culture
It ran cheap television ads late at night
It offered discounts only to first-time buyers
questions.why: Lesson 3 says free shipping, surprise upgrades and great phone service generated buzz for free.
